plugins.name: superskillret
plugins.description: Embedding-based skill retrieval. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool (ThakiCloud/SKILLRET) and injects them as context, using the ThakiCloud/SkillRet-Embedding-0.6B encoder behind a long-running local daemon. v0.3.3 makes /plugin update apply automatically: the daemon ping reply now carries its plugin version and the next prompt's hook gracefully hands over to the new version on mismatch — so SUPERSKILLRET_SCOPE (and any future boot-time setting) takes effect immediately instead of being ignored until manual /superskillret:stop. Also fixes a SIGTERM cleanup bug (zombie-daemon cascades) and migrates the user-skill pool across versions so /plugin update doesn't lose curated skills. v0.3.2 adds SUPERSKILLRET_SCOPE env var to restrict retrieval to the user pool only (or system pool only). v0.3.1 adds /superskillret:setup for one-shot sync install + daemon spawn. v0.3.0 PLUGIN_ROOT resolution. v0.2.9 Python 3.9 compat. v0.2.8 daemon health line + list/remove cli. v0.2.0–0.2.7 custom skill registration + UX fixes.
